text: Nvidia made over a hundred billion dollars from data centres in just three months!
Why does everyone buy from one company?
Because AI runs on its chips, and analysts estimate roughly eight in ten AI chips are Nvidia's.
Software. CUDA is twenty years old, and Nvidia says eleven million developers build on it. Switching means rewriting a lot of code.
Google and Amazon build their own chips, and AI labs rent them by the hundreds of thousands.
So Nvidia could lose its lead?
Maybe. But almost all of them wait in the same queue, at TSMC's chip-packaging lines in Taiwan.
And analysts say Nvidia holds the biggest place in that queue.
Like, follow History Sketches, and tell us what we should map next!
That's how you make over a hundred billion dollars in three months.
